screens.title: 홈 · 풀업 접힘
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity Korean iOS app UI, a screen design ready to discuss with a product designer. Product is 날담 (naldam), a daily-question personal journal with independent solo value plus optional discovery and 1:1 chats. Brand uses first reference PAPER logo: terracotta #BC684C, ivory #F7F3EC, near-white paper #FFFDFA, dark espresso #3D302B, secondary taupe #897D73. Exact logo silhouette is the rounded page with separated curved folded top-right corner, never the envelope brand symbol. Use refined Korean sans-serif, strong legibility, larger editorial headings, consistent 20–24pt spacing, restrained dividers and subtle shadows, elegant and practical. No giant marketing blobs, no dashboard charts, no photorealistic desk, no external phone frame, no perspective, no surrounding presentation labels. Draw a SINGLE straight-on full-bleed iPhone app screenshot, tall portrait aspect 9:19.5, approximately 402×874 logical points, high resolution. Standard top status bar 9:41 with Dynamic Island, safe bottom home indicator. All UI copy in accurate Korean; quote text provided exactly; do not repeat or invent paragraphs. Screen mock content is fictional. Keep content comfortably within safe areas.

Navigation material rule: only the floating bottom navigation/control layer uses restrained regular Liquid Glass: a translucent milky-white pill with background blur, thin luminous edge and subtle refraction; text and glyphs have strong dark contrast. Never glassify content cards. Three stable tabs exactly "홈", "발견", "대화", one recognizable line/fill icon above each small Korean label. Active icon/label is terracotta inside a subtle pale warm selection capsule. Bottom bar roughly x28 y786 w346 h sixty-something logical pt, above home indicator. No opaque brown rectangular legacy tab bar.

Redesign target: reference 2 shows legacy home / custom envelope pull-up states. Preserve its interaction idea and its distinct paper-and-envelope shape while modernizing proportions. Reference 1 is selected brand identity only; do not recreate the brand board.

SCREEN 01 / HOME with COLLAPSED ENVELOPE. Draw only the home screenshot.
Header: compact terracotta paper brand mark and "날담" wordmark at upper left, small round profile avatar showing the Korean initial "상" upper right.
Small date "10월 2일 금요일". Compact welcoming headline "오늘의 나를 담아볼까요?"
The hero occupies upper-middle area: opaque ivory-white paper card with slightly lifted folded top-right corner, small terracotta eyebrow "오늘의 질문", large beautifully wrapped question "오늘, 나를 가장\n웃게 한 순간은?", support "짧은 한 줄도 괜찮아요.", tiny lock and "나만 보기", prominent full-width terracotta button "오늘 기록하기". This question and button are the primary focus.
Below, compact flat weekly strip, not a large statistics card: heading "이번 주, 세 번의 기록", weekday row "월 화 수 목 금 토 일" with seven small rounded cells. Monday Tuesday Thursday show small terracotta completion checks; Wednesday empty, Friday outlined current day, Saturday and Sunday muted future. No charts or scoring.
Next, one small horizontal revisit row: left tiny paper thumbnail, title "다시 꺼내보는 나", excerpt "산책에서 찾은 작은 여유", right chevron. Keep it compact so the screen is not crowded.

The bottom approximately quarter of home is the COLLAPSED custom pull-up envelope component. This is a fixed anchored bottom interaction, not a floating ordinary card. A wide white letter sheet rises with a shallow arched/domed top centered on the screen, from a pale kraft envelope pocket anchored to the bottom behind the glass bar. The rounded paper top is visibly continuous and extends toward both screen edges. A small round terracotta handle with upward chevron sits exactly at its top center. One tiny hint "위로 당겨 펼치기". On the visible sheet a small circle avatar with initial "상", the title "나의 관심사", and three compact chips "독서", "산책", "음악" arranged neatly near the avatar, only one row or shallow arc. Maintain compact scale; don't let the sheet cover the hero or week strip. At the very bottom of the component visible pale tan envelope front flaps meet with a gentle V seam; the floating glass tab bar is layered in front without covering text or chips. This same sheet/avatar/chips/handle will later rise into middle and full states, so visually establish a clean distinctive component. All content ends above bottom tab bar; home is scrollable if needed.
Active bottom tab "홈"; other tabs "발견" and "대화". No messages notification badges on this screen. Do not show a keyboard.

Screen captured with keyboard dismissed, not actively typing; no keyboard/caret. No social share button by default, no streak or points.
